lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximate vertical columns along the visible posterior flank and caudal peduncle; spatial distribution follows a grid-like pattern relative to the horizontal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a grid of high-luminance nodes clearly visible on the mid-lateral and posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent longitudinal ridge extending from the posterior base of the first dorsal fin toward the caudal peduncle, characterized by a distinct shadow-to-light gradient along its horizontal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-luminance blobs visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, with a distribution of approximately 5-8 discernable points within the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular notch or indentation on the posterior margin of the upper lobe of the caudal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense aggregation of approximately 20-30 small teleost fish (commensals) clustered around the ventral-posterior flank and trailing behind the pelvic region.
